title: HBO Max announces September 2026 lineup with new titles and Emmy
subtitle: The streaming platform unveiled a vast selection of films, series, and documentaries, plus a major event broadcast.
excerpt: HBO Max revealed the new additions to its catalog for September 2026, highlighting original productions, acclaimed films, and the 78th Emmy Awards.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
HBO Max released the list of films and series that will arrive on the platform in September 2026, generating great interest among subscribers. The lineup includes a wide range of content, from original telenovelas and action movies to investigative documentaries and the broadcast of one of the biggest television events worldwide, the Emmy Awards.

What arrives in September 2026 on HBO Max

September 2026 promises to be busy for HBO Max users, with a series of scheduled premieres. The platform aims to offer a new selection of titles for its subscribers, covering various genres and formats.

Featured original series and telenovelas

Among the series, the original telenovela Collision stands out, following the disputes between Belén and Zoé, mother and daughter with distinct worldviews who fight for control of their own family. Another novelty is Confined, which follows young Clara as she enters a convent dominated by Cecilia, a mother superior who turns the lives of the novices into medieval torture. YOUTH also joins the catalog, a series that explores the life of a 50‑year‑old woman seeking balance between her profession and personal life.

  • Series in September:
  • September 4 – Dogu – Seasons 1 to 4
  • September 7 – Collision
  • September 10 – Queen of the Scalpel with Dr. Carol Brandão
  • September 25 – 4 Blocks Zero
  • September 25 – Paolo
  • Yet to be dated – Confined

Films and documentary productions

For cinema lovers, HBO Max brings the film War Shark, which tells the story of a group of Australian soldiers adrift in the Timor Sea, facing conflicts, injuries, hunger, and the threat of a great great white shark. In the documentary field, Death and Mystery in the Amazon revisits rumors about the legendary city of Akakor, the focus of expeditions whose members disappeared in the 1970s and 1980s.

Reality shows, animations and sports events

The September catalog also includes new seasons of reality shows, such as The Last Lumberjacks and Survival Zone, as well as animations for diverse audiences. For sports fans, the platform will broadcast the UEFA Champions League Group Stage.

  • Live events in September:
  • September 8, 9 and 10 – UEFA Champions League, Group Stage

The 2026 Emmy Awards broadcast

One of the big highlights of the month is the broadcast of the 2026 Emmy Awards ceremony, marking the 78th edition of the event. With a start time of 8:30 p.m. (Brasília time) on September 14, the awards will feature Carol Ribeiro as presenter, who will cover the backstage and conduct interviews with nominees at one of the largest celebrations in the television industry.

With information from TecMundo.
